name: Humboldt Research Fellowship for Postdocs
amount: EUR 3,000 per month plus additional benefits
duration: 6-24 months (up to three stays within three years)
eligibility: Doctorate within the last 4 years; non-German nationals; research project agreed with a host in Germany
eligibility_note: Open to all non-German nationals ('You are not a German national.'); no country exclusions or age limit on the official page.
how_to_apply_tip: Get a written host agreement from a German professor now and submit as soon as the call opens on 15 Nov 2026: each call closes early once it reaches 800 applications.
deadline_quote: We have received the maximum number of applications for the current call. Therefore, unfortunately, no new applications can be created at present. The next call will open on November 15, 2026. ... Once a call has reached the maximum number of currently 800 applications ... the application round will be closed.
verdict_reason: Your PhD was awarded in January 2024 (defended Dec 2023), so it falls within the 4-year window for any application submitted before about Dec 2027 to Jan 2028. You are not German, and the page sets no age, gender or institution-type limits. The call has no fixed closing date and closes once it reaches 800 applications, so apply as soon as it opens on 15 Nov 2026.
eligibility_quote: Did you complete your doctorate – or equivalent academic qualification – during the last four years? ... You are not a German national.

name: Georg Forster Research Fellowship (Postdocs)
amount: EUR 3,000 per month plus additional benefits (when last offered)
eligibility: Citizens of developing/transition countries (excl. China, India); doctorate within 4 years; lived and worked in an eligible country 12 of the last 18 months
eligibility_note: Nationality rule excludes only PR China and India by name; the country list PDF governs. Programme currently suspended.
how_to_apply_tip: Do not prepare an application now. Sign up for the Humboldt newsletter to hear when the new BMZ-funded scheme for developing countries is announced, and apply to the Humboldt Research Fellowship meanwhile.
deadline_quote: Applications for Georg Forster Research Fellowships can no longer be accepted with immediate effect.
verdict_reason: You would probably fit this scheme: you are Pakistani, you work in Pakistan, and your PhD, awarded in January 2024, is within the 4-year limit. However, the Foundation has stopped accepting applications. A replacement programme is being designed with BMZ and has no launch date.
eligibility_quote: You must be a citizen of a developing or transition country – excluding PR China and India. ... It is, therefore, currently not possible to submit applications and nominations.

name: ETH Zurich Postdoctoral Fellowships (ETH Fellows)
amount: 100% ETH-standard salary + CHF 12,000 per year research expenses
eligibility: PhD max. 2 years before submission deadline; ≥1 peer-reviewed journal paper; joint application with ETH professor (mentor); mobility rules
eligibility_note: No nationality requirement; ineligible if >12 months in Switzerland in the last 3 years or PhD from ETH/UZH.
how_to_apply_tip: Find an ETH professor (e.g. in D-MAVT robotics or D-INFK) you have NOT collaborated with before. Each professor may submit only one application per round, and two reference letters must reach ethfellows@sl.ethz.ch 10 days before the deadline.
deadline_quote: There are two ETH Fellowship calls per year. Submission deadlines are 1 March and 1 September, 17:00 Swiss local time.
verdict_reason: ETH counts the defence date: you defended in Dec 2023 (degree awarded Jan 2024), about 3 years 3 months before the 1 Mar 2027 deadline, so you exceed the two-year maximum (it would need a defence on or after 1 Mar 2025).
eligibility_quote: Applicants with the doctorate (PhD) must have obtained it a maximum of two years prior to the submission deadline. The decisive date is the date of the examination or defense/viva voce. ... Applicants who resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Switzerland for more than twelve months in the three years immediately before the submission deadline are ineligible.

name: ETH AI Center Postdoctoral Fellowships
amount: 100% full-time employment contract at standard ETH Zurich salary rates (programme covers up to 50%, host labs match)
eligibility: Doctorate in hand or completed at least 3 months before start; AI research with ETH AI Center faculty
eligibility_note: Official FAQ states no nationality restriction.
how_to_apply_tip: The 2027 round closed on 27 Oct 2026. For the 2028 round, expect the portal to open mid-September 2027, and line up two referees and matching ETH AI Center faculty in advance.
deadline_quote: Applications for the 2027 doctoral and postdoctoral fellowships will open from Tuesday, September 15, 2026 until 16:00 CET on Tuesday, October 27, 2026.
verdict_reason: You hold a PhD, and the official FAQ sets no upper limit on time since PhD and no nationality, age or institution restriction. The 2027 round closed on 27 Oct 2026, so the next chance is the 2028 round.
eligibility_quote: Candidates must hold a doctorate (PhD) or will complete their doctorate at least 3 months before the beginning of the fellowship.

name: EPFL AI Center & Swiss AI Initiative Postdoctoral Fellowships (3rd call)
funder: EPFL AI Center / Swiss AI Initiative
amount: ~50% of postdoc salary per year (rest covered by EPFL host lab) + up to CHF 5,000 per year for research/travel
eligibility: PhD in CS/engineering/physics/applied maths or AI-relevant field, obtained ≤2 years before the deadline; host professor support secured before applying
eligibility_note: 'Citizens of any nationality may apply'; 'No age restrictions apply'.
how_to_apply_tip: URGENT (9 days left): email an AI Center-affiliated EPFL robotics or learning professor today with your CV and a one-paragraph project abstract. The host must commit to co-funding about 50% of your salary.
deadline_quote: The 3rd call is now open with a submission deadline on 9 November 2026 17:00 (CET).
verdict_reason: The PhD diploma must be dated no more than two years before the 9 Nov 2026 deadline, so no earlier than 9 Nov 2024. Your degree was awarded in January 2024 (defended Dec 2023), about 2 years 10 months before the deadline. Nationality and age are not barriers, but the PhD-date rule excludes you, and the page lists no extensions.
eligibility_quote: Applicants must have obtained a PhD diploma in computer science, physics, engineering ... no more than two years before the submission deadline. ... Citizens of any nationality may apply for the AI Center & Swiss AI Initiative postdoctoral fellowship programme. ... No age restrictions apply.

name: CYD Distinguished Postdoctoral Fellowships (15th call)
funder: Cyber-Defence (CYD) Campus, armasuisse S+T, via EPFL Research Office
amount: Salary contribution incl. social security at host salary scale + up to CHF 3,000 per year equipment + up to CHF 5,000 per year conferences
eligibility: Postdoc at a Swiss higher education institution in a lab different from doctoral/current lab; cyber-defence themes incl. data science & AI methods
eligibility_note: Official page: applicants of any nationality may apply; no age restrictions.
how_to_apply_tip: Frame your project as AI for cyber-defence (e.g. secure or adversarially robust robot perception, anomaly detection). Line up a Swiss professor to endorse you for Stage 2.
deadline_quote: The call opens on 3 December 2026 ... Stage 1 submission deadline: 25 February 2027 (17:00 CET).
verdict_reason: Any nationality and any age can apply, and the page sets no time-since-PhD limit. Your AI background fits the 'Data science & AI methods' theme, but a pure robotics proposal would be out of scope.
eligibility_quote: Applicants of any nationality may apply ... No age restrictions apply. ... The postdoctoral research must take place in a different lab from the applicant's doctoral lab and current postdoctoral lab.

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships – Postdoctoral Scholarships
funder: Swiss State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI) / FCS
amount: n/a (postdoc track discontinued)
eligibility: Postdoc track ends from 2027/28; only Research Fellowships (Master's holders born after 31 Dec 1991) and PhD scholarships remain
eligibility_note: Pakistan is listed for Research Fellowship/PhD tracks only; postdoctoral scholarships no longer awarded.

deadline_quote: In addition, postdoctoral scholarships will no longer be awarded from the 2027/28 academic year.
verdict_reason: The postdoctoral track no longer exists from 2027/28. The remaining Research Fellowship track requires a birth date after 31 Dec 1991, which you do not meet at 36-45.
eligibility_quote: In addition, postdoctoral scholarships will no longer be awarded from the 2027/28 academic year. (SBFI news, published 19 November 2025)

name: ISTA-Fellow International Postdoctoral Fellowship
funder: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)
amount: Min. EUR 73,500 gross per year + project budget
eligibility: PhD held at call deadline or by 15/06/2027; host group at ISTA (all except astronomy, incl. Data & Computer Science); not already employed at ISTA
eligibility_note: No nationality restriction stated in Guide for Applicants; ISTA International Office provides visa support.
how_to_apply_tip: The 2026 call closed on 8 Sep 2026. Contact an ISTA computer science or robotics-adjacent group now so your project fits the host's expertise for the 2027 call.
deadline_quote: The closing date for the Call for Proposals is 8th September, 2026 (14:00 CEST)
verdict_reason: You hold a PhD and have never worked at ISTA. The official guide sets no nationality, age, institution or time-since-PhD limit. Wait for the 2027 call.
eligibility_quote: Applicants must hold a PhD degree (or equivalent) on the date of the call deadline or anticipate completing their PhD degree before the start of their fellowship (no later than 15/06/2027). ... Researchers already employed at ISTA before 01/09/2026 are not eligible to apply.

name: FWF ESPRIT Programme
amount: Full-time senior postdoc salary (FWF rates) + EUR 45,000 lump sum for project costs
eligibility: Postdocs of all disciplines from Austria and abroad; doctorate ≤5 years at submission; ≥2 quality-assured publications; Austrian host institution submits; mentor in Austria
eligibility_note: 'addressed to highly qualified postdocs of all disciplines from Austria and abroad'; no nationality restriction.
how_to_apply_tip: Find a mentor at an Austrian university (e.g. TU Wien, TU Graz, JKU Linz robotics or AI labs). The host institution submits through FWF elane. You must leave or take leave from your current post for the 36 months.
deadline_quote: There are no submission deadlines for this program; applications can be submitted at any time.
verdict_reason: Your PhD was awarded in January 2024, so it is about 2 years 10 months old now and stays within the 5-year limit at application until January 2029. Your publication record (h-index 18) easily meets the two-publication rule. The permanent-post exclusion applies only to posts at the applying Austrian institution, so your BIC post does not block you, but you must take leave from it for the 36 months.
eligibility_quote: The ESPRIT program is addressed to highly qualified postdocs of all disciplines from Austria and abroad at the beginning of their academic career ... The doctoral degree of principal investigators must have been awarded no more than five years at the time of application ... Persons who at the time of submitting the application already have a position at the applying research institution that includes the prospect of permanent employment ... cannot serve as the principal investigator.

name: Government of Ireland Postdoctoral Fellowship (GOIPD)
amount: n/a (programme closed)
eligibility: Programme integrated into institution-level 'Empower' programme; no individual applications
eligibility_note: Individual call no longer exists; Empower is an invited institutional call to 18 Irish HEIs.
how_to_apply_tip: Not applicable for you: approach Irish universities directly about postdocs funded through their Empower allocations.
deadline_quote: The Government of Ireland Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme is now closed and has been integrated into the newly established Empower programme.

eligibility_quote: Research Ireland will peer review and assess institutional applications rather than applications from individual scholars and researchers, with funding awarded at an institutional level. The Empower programme is an invited call open to 18 eligible Higher Education Institutions (HEIs).

name: FWO Junior Postdoctoral Fellowship
amount: Full postdoc salary (FWO scales) + bench fee
eligibility: PhD ≤3 years before 1 October of the start year; host at a Flemish university
eligibility_note: Official FWO page could not be opened (HTTP 503 / TLS failure); a university pointer page gives no nationality restriction.
how_to_apply_tip: Find a supervisor at KU Leuven, UGent, VUB, UAntwerp or UHasselt robotics/AI groups now. The deadline has moved from 1 Dec to mid-November, so check fwo.be immediately.
deadline_quote: (Unverified on funder domain) Hasselt University call notice for the 2026 round: 'Submission deadline is 17 November 2025, 5 P.M.'
verdict_reason: The PhD must have been obtained no more than 3 years before 1 October of the year the fellowship starts. The next call (deadline about Nov-Dec 2026) funds fellowships starting 1 Oct 2027, so your PhD would need to date from 1 Oct 2024 or later. Yours was awarded in January 2024 (defended Dec 2023), about 3 years 9 months before that date, so you are excluded from this and any later call. FWO's own pages returned HTTP 503, so the rule comes from two Flemish host universities that state it the same way.
eligibility_quote: (UAntwerp FWO page) "your PhD was obtained not longer than 3 years before the 1st of October of the year in which the fellowship would start" ... "Start of fellowship: 1 October or 1 November". (Hasselt University pointer page) PhD must have been awarded 'maximum three years before the first of October of the year in which the fellowship commences.'

name: F.R.S.-FNRS Postdoctoral Researcher Fellowship (CR – Chargé·e de recherches)
amount: Full-time fixed-term postdoc employment contract (FNRS scales)
eligibility: PhD ≤5 years at rectors' validation deadline; research at a university of the French-speaking Community of Belgium with a permanently appointed promoter
eligibility_note: Rules and Regulations contain no nationality condition.
how_to_apply_tip: Find a promoter at UCLouvain, ULB, ULiège or UMONS (robotics/AI) now. The call usually opens in December and the applicant validation deadline falls in early January (8 Jan in 2026).
deadline_quote: (2026 call, mini-guide) Opening of the call: WEDNESDAY, 10TH DECEMBER 2025 ... Postdoctoral Researcher CR ... APPLICANT Thursday 8th January at 2 p.m.
verdict_reason: The 5-year limit runs to the rectors' validation deadline of the call. For the 2027 call (early 2027) your PhD, defended December 2023 and awarded January 2024, will be about 3 years old, and it stays within the limit through the 2028 call. The regulations set no nationality, age or home-institution restrictions. You need a permanently appointed promoter at a French-speaking Belgian university. The 2027 call dates are not yet published.
eligibility_quote: Article 4: Applicants to a Postdoctoral Researcher fellowship must have obtained the academic degree as referred to in Article 3 for maximum 5 years. This term shall expire at the latest on the validation deadline set for the academic authorities (rectors) to validate applications. ... Holders of a Postdoctoral Researcher (CR) fellowship shall carry out a Postdoctoral-level research work in a university of the French-speaking Community of Belgium under the supervision of a promoter.

name: DFG Walter Benjamin Programme (position in Germany)
amount: Postdoc position (salary per DFG personnel rates) + EUR 250 per month direct project costs
eligibility: Early-career postdocs (EU R2 'recognised researcher' level); German host institution's employer declaration; usually change of institution
eligibility_note: 'Researchers based abroad can apply for the position irrespective of nationality.'
how_to_apply_tip: Get a German host and the 'Employer's declaration' (DFG form 41.027) plus proof a local researcher supports your career. Submit via elan at any time.
deadline_quote: Proposals may be submitted at any time. ... No formal deadline for submission of proposals is specified in the programme.
verdict_reason: Your nationality fits and the call is always open, and the DFG sets no fixed year limit (only an 'early phase after completion of the doctorate'); with your PhD awarded Jan 2024 (~3 years) and an Associate Professor title, it is unclear whether the DFG would still count you as early career (R2).
eligibility_quote: Only postdoctoral researchers at an early career phase are eligible to apply to this programme. ... Researchers based abroad can apply for the position irrespective of nationality.
ask_funder: My PhD in Electrical Engineering was awarded in January 2024 (defended Dec 2023) and I hold the title Associate Professor at a private teaching college in Pakistan. Does the DFG consider me to be in the 'early postdoctoral phase' (R2) for a Walter Benjamin position?

name: DAAD Research Grants in Germany (postdoc stays)
amount: Monthly stipend per DAAD rates + insurance contribution (see call)
eligibility: Postdocs up to 4 years after doctorate; resident in Germany ≤15 months; project at a German university/research institute with supervisor
eligibility_note: Pakistan-specific application deadline published in the DAAD database (origin = Pakistan).
how_to_apply_tip: The Pakistan round closed on 31 Aug 2026. Prepare a host invitation letter for the next round (Pakistani deadlines usually fall at the end of August) and check the database in Q2 2027.
deadline_quote: You can find the current dates here: 31.08.2026 Selection date in February 2027 Start of funding in May 2027 at the earliest
verdict_reason: The limit is 4 years from completing the doctorate to the application deadline. If the next Pakistan deadline falls around end-August 2027, your PhD will be about 3 years 8 months old counting from the December 2023 defence (3 years 7 months from the January 2024 award), so you pass. An August 2028 deadline would fail, which makes the next round your last. You live in Pakistan, which has its own deadline. This is a short 2-6 month postdoc stay, not a long fellowship.
eligibility_quote: Postdocs: You should not have completed your doctorate more than 4 years before the application deadline. ... Your application cannot be considered, if you have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

name: DAAD Heilbronn AI Fellowships
funder: German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) / Bildungscampus Heilbronn
amount: EUR 2,800 per month + insurance + travel lump sum (+ family benefits >6 months)
eligibility: PhD ≤5 years before application; AI or related field; affiliated with a university or non-university research institution; outside Germany for 15 months; host on Bildungscampus Heilbronn (TUM Heilbronn, HHN, DHBW, Fraunhofer, MPI etc.)
eligibility_note: Pakistan appears in the programme's applicant-country list; no nationality exclusion.
how_to_apply_tip: Email heilbronn-ai@daad.de to be matched with a host (e.g. TUM Campus Heilbronn). Apply at least 4 months before your intended start, and check that the portal is accepting applications.
deadline_quote: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis and may be submitted at any time. To allow sufficient time for the review and selection process, applications should generally be submitted at least four months before the intended start of the fellowship. [Portal notice: 'Currently you cannot apply for this programme.']
verdict_reason: Your PhD was awarded in January 2024, under 3 years ago, so it is well within the 5-year limit, and your AI field and residence outside Germany also fit. Two points are unclear: whether BIC, a private TNE college, counts as a 'university or non-university research institution', and why the portal currently says applications are not possible despite the rolling deadline.
eligibility_quote: International PhD candidates or postdoctoral researchers who obtained a PhD/doctorate no more than five years ago ... be affiliated with a university or non-university research institution ... Applicants must have been residing outside Germany throughout the 15 months prior to submitting their application.
ask_funder: I am an Associate Professor at Beaconhouse International College (a private college in Pakistan delivering UK university degrees). Does this count as affiliation with a 'university or non-university research institution', and when will the portal accept applications again?

name: DAAD AInet Fellowship (Postdoctoral Networking Tour in AI)
amount: Virtual networking week + one-week travel stipend to Germany; access to exclusive 1-3 month short-term research funding
duration: 1 week trip (+ optional 1-3 month research stay)
eligibility: International early-career AI researchers; PhD ≤5 years; not affiliated with a German institution in the last 2 years
eligibility_note: Open to international researchers; no nationality restriction stated.
how_to_apply_tip: Awarded twice a year on a changing AI theme (Nov 2026 was 'Reliable AI'). Watch the page for the next theme and apply when it matches robotics or embodied AI.
deadline_quote: The DAAD AInet Fellowship is awarded twice a year ... The Virtual Networking Week will take place from November 2 - 6, 2026. All applicants have received their results.
verdict_reason: Your PhD was awarded Jan 2024, well within the 5-year limit; your record is strong (h-index 18) and you have no German affiliation. This is a networking fellowship leading to a short-stay grant, not a salaried postdoc.
eligibility_quote: Candidates should have: a very strong scientific track record ... obtained a PhD/doctorate no longer than 5 years ago ... not been affiliated with a German institution during the last two years.

name: DDSA Postdoc Fellowship
funder: Danish Data Science Academy (funded by Novo Nordisk Foundation)
amount: DKK 1,300,000 (+5% admin) per fellowship
eligibility: PhD ≤6 years before deadline; own data-science project at a Danish research institution; ≤2 years prior postdoc at host
eligibility_note: Call encourages candidates 'irrespective of age, gender, race, ethnicity, disability, nationality, or religion'.
how_to_apply_tip: Past calls closed in late Feb or early March. Secure a Danish host (e.g. DTU, Aalborg robotics, Pioneer Centre for AI) by January and frame the project as data science or ML methodology.
deadline_quote: Deadline for submitting your final application is on March 4, 2026, at 23:59 (UTC + 01:00).
verdict_reason: Your PhD was awarded in January 2024, about 3 years before a likely early-2027 deadline, well within the 6-year limit. Nationality and age are explicitly not barriers, and the only other requirement is a Danish host. The 2027 call has not been announced.
eligibility_quote: You must have received your PhD Diploma no more than 6 years prior to the application deadline ... All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, race, ethnicity, disability, nationality, or religion ... The host institution must be a Danish research institution within the field of your postdoc project.

name: Carlsberg Foundation Internationalisation Fellowships
amount: Full salary + DKK 8,000 per month operating costs (+ family supplements abroad)
eligibility: PhD from a Danish, Greenlandic or Faroese institution; PhD ≤3 years old
eligibility_note: Nationality not restricted, but a Danish/Greenlandic/Faroese PhD is mandatory.
how_to_apply_tip: Not applicable for you unless your PhD was awarded in Denmark.

verdict_reason: You do not hold a PhD from a Danish, Greenlandic or Faroese institution, which the scheme requires. Separately, your PhD was awarded in January 2024, so it will be about 3.2 years old at the 1 Apr 2027 deadline, past the scheme's 3-year limit.
eligibility_quote: The PhD degree must have been obtained from a Danish, Greenlandic, or Faroese research institution.

name: Digital Futures Postdoc Fellows in Technologies for Digital Transformation
funder: Digital Futures (KTH Royal Institute of Technology / Stockholm University / RISE)
amount: SEK 2.4 million toward salary costs for two years
eligibility: Own project with KTH/SU main supervisor + Digital Futures co-supervisor; doctorate awarded before start

ask_funder: Is there a maximum time since PhD for the Digital Futures postdoc fellows call (my PhD was awarded in January 2024), and when is the next call expected?

name: Academy Research Fellowship 2027 (all research fields)
amount: Up to EUR 700,000
eligibility: First doctoral degree certificate dated 1 Jan 2020 – 31 Dec 2024; Finnish host organisation; close connection with Finland during funding
eligibility_note: Call requires equal treatment 'regardless of nationality'; no nationality bar.
how_to_apply_tip: Check the date printed on your PhD certificate first. Only one dated December 2024 qualifies. If eligible, you need a Finnish host (e.g. Aalto, Tampere, Oulu robotics) to back you before 11 Nov 2026.
deadline_quote: The deadline for applications is 11 November 2026 at 23.59 Finnish time.
verdict_reason: This hinges on the date on your PhD certificate. The window ends 31 Dec 2024, so you qualify only if the certificate is dated December 2024. A 2025 or later date makes you ineligible.
eligibility_quote: ... whose first doctoral degree certificate is dated between 1 January 2020 and 31 December 2024. ... The PI of the funded project must have a close connection with Finland during the whole funding period.
ask_funder: My first doctoral degree certificate is dated <DATE>. Am I within the 2027 Academy Research Fellowship window, and can a researcher currently based in Pakistan apply with a Finnish host if they relocate for the full period?

name: FNR ATTRACT (Starting Investigator)
amount: Up to EUR 1.5 million (Starting) / EUR 2 million (Consolidating)
eligibility: 2-8 years R&D experience after doctorate; joint proposal with Luxembourg host institution
eligibility_note: No nationality rule on page; targets researchers 'not yet established in Luxembourg'. (FNR has no individual postdoc fellowship; Industrial Fellowships ended in 2026.)
how_to_apply_tip: Revisit once you are 2 or more years past your PhD. University of Luxembourg's SnT robotics/AI groups are natural hosts.
deadline_quote: Deadline: 17-11-2026 14:00 CET (pre-proposals) 16-02-2027 14:00 CET (full proposals)
verdict_reason: Your PhD was awarded Jan 2024 (defended Dec 2023), giving about 2 years 10 months of post-PhD experience at the 17 Nov 2026 pre-proposal deadline (about 3 years 1 month at the 16 Feb 2027 full-proposal deadline), inside the 2-8 year window; no nationality rule is stated and you are not established in Luxembourg. You must submit jointly with a Luxembourg host (check its internal deadline); this is a group-leader grant, not a postdoc fellowship.
eligibility_quote: "Researchers are eligible between 2 and 8 years after their PhD" / "2 – 8 years proven experience in the R&D context, following the successful completion of a doctoral degree." / "The ATTRACT programme is designed for researchers not yet established in Luxembourg" / "Research proposals must be submitted jointly by the candidate and host institution" / "17-11-2026 14:00 CET (pre-proposals)"; "16-02-2027 14:00 CET (full proposals)"
